description: GitHub search with its own query syntax (e.g. 'sqlite language:rust stars:>100'). Repositories: name, owner, stars, forks, language, topics, licence, pushed date. Issues: title, state, labels, comments, URL. Code: path, repository and link. GitHub limits search to about 30 requests a minute; a busy minute is a 503, not charged. Limit max 30. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
